method.comparison: whole 512-halfword output windows before/after, separating formal output lattice from extra physical writes

closed_rule.condition: incoming source pointer R0 has bit1 set (src mod4 == 2)
per_row_before_formal_stream2: swap u16 at out2_row_start - 8 bytes with u16 at out2_row_start - 4 bytes
then perform the formal stream2 writes
closed_rule.stream1_extra_writes: none observed in all five random-destination cases
closed_rule.proof: Both source-phase1 cases swap the two pre-row destination halfwords before every row even when outputs are aligned; both source-phase0 controls have no extra writes even when outputs are mod4==2. Every swap pair is exact: the lower address receives the prior value from +2 halfword indices and the higher address receives the prior value from -2 halfword indices.

relation_to_prior_evidence.GREENORACLE6M: 6M correctly disproved an unconditional single out2-4 scratch write, but its uniform destination sentinel could not reveal a permutation of equal neighboring values.
relation_to_prior_evidence.BFINSCALAR3C: formal logical arithmetic parity remains valid; that test did not compare non-formal physical destination locations.
relation_to_prior_evidence.GREENORACLE6L_pre6N: the C-plane mismatch addresses map to these pre-row swap cells; later Green helpers overwrite one member of most pairs, explaining why only one member survives in the final buffer after row 0.
